notes.title: Version 0.0.10
notes.content:
[b]Attention, all saved data will be lost.[/b]
If an error occurs, delete the old save game.

[list]
[*] if a unit dies, it does not become upgraded
[*] improved flying AI. Now does not skip a turn near an enemy when it can attack
[*] fixed effect of "Double strike" spell
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.0.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39238345/8dc7d6bfc07ccb586e6cc772af3262f510ba2e5b.jpg[/img]
- duplicate units do not appear in the tavern
- the druid Ulmus shows a sign that you can take the "quest"
- fixed receiving a reward when skipping a dialogue
- a new artifact is put on the hero if the slot is free
- updated the "Hero" icon in the hero window
- the dialog changes by clicking on the dialog box, and not by any click
- when aiming at the enemy, the possible number of killed units is displayed
- fixed spell "berserk"
- units are no longer called to the same place
- flying units do not stand on an occupied cell
- adapted window size for small screens
